information_gaps.text: The newest satellite crop data is not in yet. This month uses weather only.
The model covers March to October. Treat this month with care.
How much spring barley suffers in each month is our first estimate. It has not been checked against field trials.
For some months we do not know how this crop reacts. Those months show the general risk for crops.
